scenario.purpose: compare crop-management policies on the fixed selected rotation under observed 2020-2023 weather

objectives: minimize mineral-N shortfall relative to fixed-map baseline
limitations: The crop map is fixed before NSGA-II; the optimizer changes management policies, not the rotation sequence.
The 2019 simulation is used only for state carry-over and is excluded from objectives.
Fertilizer prices, crop prices, application cost, and other cost are diagnostic proxies inherited from the existing project.
Forage has no confirmed sale price, so its revenue is zero in the profit proxy while its biomass remains in the yield objective.
Soil objective is normalized mineral-N shortfall relative to the fixed-map APSIM baseline, not a confirmed agronomic target interval.
Rye and the clover-timothy stand remain documented structural proxies.
Whole-profile model Humic must not decline over the evaluated period on any field; this is not a validated laboratory humus constraint.
P, K, normative humus targets and seed-cost differences are not optimized because confirmed inputs are unavailable.
